description: Read and change this account through its signed-in product routes. Change AI and model-training privacy settings in the app. Sportsbook actions follow the app's plan permissions. Bug-report actions use server reports, separate from reports held only on a device; those routes must be enabled. preferences: GET account; set_preferences: POST account/preferences {roastLevel?, morningRounds?, unitMinor?, bankrollMinor?, oddsFormat?, gradeDepthDefault?}; use set_timezone for timezone; favorite_teams: GET account/favorite-teams Saved priority team IDs, separate from Settings sports preferences; set_favorite_teams: POST account/favorite-teams {favoriteTeamIds: string[]}; replaces the saved priority list; sports_preferences: GET account/onboarding-preferences Settings leagues and teams; set_sports_preferences: POST account/onboarding-preferences {selections, mode, expectedRevision, confirmed: true}; read current selections and revision first; merge keeps existing selections, replace replaces the entire list; send only after the owner confirms; use onboarding_preferences catalog and teams for current source IDs; set_timezone: POST account/timezone {timezone}; quota: GET account/quota; book_balances: GET sportsbooks/balances; set_book_currency: POST sportsbooks/currency {accountId, identityDigest, expectedRevision, currency: supported uppercase three-letter code with two decimal places | null, confirmation: ACCOUNT_CURRENCY}; send only after the owner confirms; seen_books: GET sportsbooks/seen; bug_report: POST bug-reports {area, whatHappened, whatExpected?, app?}; bug_reports: GET bug-reports; bug_rewards: GET bug-reports/rewards. Confirm the requested change with the customer before a write. A valid write is sent without a separate MCP preview unless the action says otherwise.
